Sections.Name: Persistence
Sections.Description: Controls whether owned transport remains as physical objects when left behind.

Keys.Name: PhysicalPersistence
Keys.Description: Physical Horse & Wagon Persistence. On: horse and wagon positions persist when left behind. Off: remote positions are forgotten and owned transport is recalled for vanilla-style transport and wagon access; the moving trailing wagon remains. Re-enabling starts fresh with owned transport at the player.

Keys.Name: ShowTrailingWagon
Keys.Description: Trailing Wagon While Riding. When disabled, hides only the wagon that trails behind you in Cart mode. Deployed and following wagons, cargo storage, physical persistence, and wagon gameplay remain enabled.

Sections.Name: Following
Sections.Description: Controls how owned transport follows the player.

Keys.Name: HorseFollowDistance
Keys.Description: Horse Follow Distance. Sets how closely a following horse stays behind you. This also applies to the horse leading a following wagon.

Keys.Name: AvoidCombat
Keys.Description: Following Horse Avoids Combat. When enabled, a following horse or horse-and-wagon team will try to keep away from hostile enemies during combat.

Keys.Name: FollowFastTravel
Keys.Description: Following Transport Fast Travels With You. When disabled, transport currently commanded to Follow waits where it was when fast travel begins.

Sections.Name: WagonAccess
Sections.Description: Controls entrance-associated wagon access from interiors.

Keys.Name: InteriorAccessDistance
Keys.Description: Interior Wagon Access Distance. Sets how close your wagon must be parked to a building or dungeon entrance to access it from inside.

Sections.Name: Hotkeys
Sections.Description: Optional keyboard shortcuts. Enter a Unity KeyCode name, or None to disable a shortcut.

Keys.Name: QuickMountDismount
Keys.Description: Quick Mount / Dismount. Mounts your last-used horse or wagon using the same range and ownership rules as the Transport menu. Pressing it while riding dismounts immediately. Enter a Unity KeyCode name such as K, F10, or Keypad5; use None to disable.

Keys.Name: SummonTransport
Keys.Description: Summon Horse & Wagon. Teleports owned transport to a nearby layout while outdoors. Enter a Unity KeyCode name such as G, F10, or Keypad5; use None to disable.
